verdict.rationale: Render explicitly ships ephemeral preview environments for full application architectures per change, documents a mechanism to prevent non-production environments from accessing production services, and supports spinning up short-lived instances to inspect runtime or run one-off commands without touching production. Together these give AI-native users a documented, isolated sandbox path distinct from production data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that preview environments fully isolate data, and explicit guidance on seeding sandbox data for AI agent testing.
